subject.title: fix(state): stop Voice Wake migration conflict startup loops

question: Should OpenClaw permanently run the new dedicated Voice Wake foreground-proof workflow on relevant pull requests, or should the repository keep the new process regression within its existing command-test coverage only?
rationale: The migration behavior is a bounded bug fix, but the added workflow and 500-line proof harness establish a continuing CI and maintenance commitment that cannot be resolved from correctness evidence alone.

options.title: Keep a focused permanent proof gate
options.body: Retain the workflow if maintainers want isolated two-boot Gateway convergence evidence as a durable CI contract for this migration boundary.

options.title: Use existing process coverage
options.body: Keep the migration and process regression tests but remove the bespoke workflow and proof script, avoiding a dedicated CI surface for one state-migration scenario.

recommendation.title: Use existing process coverage
recommendation.body: Keep the migration and process regression tests but remove the bespoke workflow and proof script, avoiding a dedicated CI surface for one state-migration scenario.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this contributor to the report, implementation, and proof design; a current-main area owner could not be established from local history in this sandbox.
